gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-gf-kadwa: Big, bold, unmistakable. Baloo Tamma 2 sets a tall-lowercase headline with generous counters, and Kadwa follows as a classic serif whose open-ended curves and larger x-height keep a long page easy going.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-gf-noticia-text: Baloo Tamma 2 stands out for its big counters, a tall lowercase that never clogs a bowl. Noticia Text takes over with a literary text serif, its curves entered through visible hooks, and it would feel cramped if the heading shrank too far.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-gf-piazzolla: Baloo Tamma 2 is all generous counters and tall lowercase, a heading that never closes up a bowl. And Piazzolla, a classic serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and a pried-open e, does the quieter work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-gf-pridi: Pridi reads like a classic serif with small letters standing nearly capital-sized, and spacious gaps where curves meet stems. Pridi's refined texture carries a long page comfortably while Baloo Tamma 2 pushes its commanding headline above.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a bookish, dignified text serif, its tall a, e and s opening wide inside. Baloo Tamma 2 above can go bigger; the body is happy at modest sizes.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-epunda-slab: Baloo Tammudu 2 leads with tall rounded lowercase and an e that stays open, making a distinctive display voice. But Epunda Slab, with its visibly gaping c, is the one that handles steady, dignified reading underneath.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a literary text serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Fauna One gives the e a generous entry, so paragraphs stay legible beneath the rounded, commanding Baloo Tammudu 2.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo brings big counters and curves with wide, unclosed mouths to the body. Glegoo is the quiet strength here, a serif that opens up beneath the tall rounded forms of Baloo Tammudu 2.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-graduate: Graduate reads like a bookish classic serif, with generous white between letters and capitals barely taller than lowercase. But Baloo Tammudu 2 does the showy work, its curves shifting in weight, while Graduate holds every stem and join uniform.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads as a traditional text serif, high-waisted in its lowercase with wide-set terminals on the s. And Baloo Tammudu 2 handles the headline, tall and rounded with an open e, leaving Hanuman to carry the refined, steady text.
